title: Remediate Item 10 provenance and authority separation
description: Implement Mission V1.5 provenance capabilities P1/P3/P4 after Item 10 B4 fail-closed finding. Primary Review must be provider-derived from exact-head GitHub Actions verify + phase-a facts, Executor-authored REVIEW evidence must be rejected, Executor-authored VERIFICATION evidence must be rejected, and Human Approval must remain separate from Review/Verification/Security. Preserve all existing protection, artifact-binding, Security, Human and Lock controls.

why_high: This task modifies the Merge Policy Controller, which directly governs merge eligibility.
The remediation changes trust-boundary and evidence-authority semantics required by frozen Mission V1.5.
A defect could permit self-review/self-verification or incorrectly block legitimate protected merges.

remediation.root_cause: Current gate-comment trust authenticates repository-owner transport but does not distinguish Executor-authored REVIEW from Deterministic Review authority. REVIEW comment can therefore substitute for independent Primary Review.
remediation.p1: Primary Review becomes machine-derived from exact-head GitHub Actions provider facts, not Executor comment evidence.
remediation.p2: Existing exact artifact binding remains mandatory.
remediation.p3: Any comment-carried REVIEW attempt is classified UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEW_EVIDENCE and cannot satisfy Review.
remediation.p4: Any comment-carried VERIFICATION attempt is classified UNAUTHORIZED_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE; verification authority remains exact-head GitHub Actions provider facts.
remediation.rule: merge-policy itself is not used to derive Primary Review, avoiding self-referential review.

acceptance_criteria.description: Task Contract is committed before controller/test implementation.
Primary Review PASS is derived only from exact-head verify + phase-a GitHub Actions check facts with integration id 15368.
Executor/comment REVIEW PASS attempts are recorded as UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEW_EVIDENCE, never current REVIEW, and block merge.
Executor/comment VERIFICATION PASS attempts are recorded as UNAUTHORIZED_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE and cannot substitute for provider verification.
Deterministic Review remains exact-artifact and exact-head bound.
A failed/not-executed verify or phase-a provider check prevents deterministic Review PASS.
Wrong integration identity cannot produce provider PASS because check retrieval remains integration-id filtered.
Human Approval remains owner-only and cannot satisfy Review, Verification or Security.
Existing Security, Human, Lock, Scope, Risk, protection, stale-evidence and exact-artifact controls remain non-regressed.
PR-mode Merge Policy may wait/fail closed until verify + phase-a provider facts are PASS, without relying on merge-policy itself for Primary Review.
Merge execution revalidates verify, phase-a and merge-policy required checks and independently rebuilds deterministic Review from verify + phase-a.
P1, P2, P3 and P4 are documented as machine-verifiably PASS only after exact-head CI, Phase A and controller tests pass.
Exact-head REVIEW/SECURITY/ACTIVE LOCK and Owner HUMAN approval are required for this HIGH remediation artifact before protected merge.
Protected merge and exact-SHA post-merge pnpm verify + Phase A must PASS before remediation becomes canonical.

external_gate_evidence.rule: REVIEW comments are not valid Primary Review evidence after this remediation. Primary Review is derived by the controller from exact-head verify + phase-a provider facts.
